rationale: Post-evaluation AI correction of the omission identified in fam-names-02-u03. Preserve the existing documentation requirement and restore the enumerated acceptable means, including the two court-order/decree alternatives, without making every document type mandatory. Retain the married-name exception as an unresolved source reference; its operative scope is not assembled here. The acting party is not assigned from this passive sentence. The alternatives remain exact, uninterpreted source text rather than executable logic.

replacements.summary: Material discrepancies between the application name and evidence of citizenship or nationality or identity must be documented by one or more of the listed acceptable means: court orders or decrees (name change orders or divorce decrees), certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation of a name change by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage. The source points to an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
